newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Assets says president Fox resigns.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Assets says president Fox resigns.

text.p: Commercial Assets Inc said Monday Leslie Fox has resigned her position as president and chief operating officer of the company to pursue other interests.
Fox will continue to work with the company through a transition period as the company searches for a successor, Commercial Assets said.
Thomas Rhodes, currently the co-chairman of the board of directors and co-chief executive officer of the company, will assume the role of President during the interim, the company said.
